title: K004: Extend E2E test assertions across deployments
summary: All three E2E test scripts (Docker, systemd, Kubernetes) were extended from 2-3 counter assertions to 8 counters each: registration_count, heartbeat_count, state_count, capabilities_count, drift_count, metrics_count, logs_count, audit_count. Kubernetes additionally gained the previously missing state_count assertion. Failure blocks in all scripts print all 8 counter values for debugging. All three reference docs were updated with 8-counter tables and expanded JSON examples. No timeouts or polling intervals were changed. Code follows existing jq extraction patterns and UPPER_SNAKE_CASE variable naming conventions consistently.
